rubrics.justification: Describes a viable expanded/early-expanded blastocyst with B-grade ICM and cohesive TE, consistent with the reported 3BA; appropriately notes uncertainty from a single static image. Minor possible overinterpretation of zona thinning/hatching limits a perfect score.
Thoroughly integrates maternal age, ovarian reserve, BMI, diagnosis, sperm parameters, endometrium, smoking, partner age, and first-cycle status with embryo quality and prognosis.

Reasoning is logical and internally consistent, especially emphasizing age-related aneuploidy over morphology. Slight tension between calling the overall case favorable and giving a relatively conservative implantation estimate, but still coherent.

Generally aligned with Gardner grading interpretation and standard IVF counseling: proceed with transfer, SET appropriate, optimize smoking/alcohol, consider PGT-A at age 38. Minor deviations include somewhat assertive comments on endometrial thickness favorability and broad endorsement of PGT-A without fuller nuance.

Provides clear practical recommendations for the current transfer and contingency planning for future cycles, including luteal support review, lifestyle modification, cycle review, uterine/transfer assessment, and consideration of embryo banking/PGT-A.
